notes: 1.10.8 - the updater can now update NeoForge too. If the pack needs a newer NeoForge than you are running, Update Now handles it instead of leaving you with a game that will not start. Prism and MultiMC are updated automatically. The Minecraft launcher gets NeoForge installed automatically. CurseForge and Modrinth App show you exactly which setting to change - those two store the loader in a way that cannot be edited safely from outside. Everything else from 1.10.x is unchanged.
